rules.sentence: Thrombocytopenia, defined by a platelet count below 150,000/µL, encompasses a spectrum of clinical presentations ranging from asymptomatic mild cases to severe forms with life-threatening bleeding or thrombotic complications.

Prompt recognition of emergencies such as heparin-induced thrombocytopenia, thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, hemolytic uremic syndrome, or pregnancy-associated thrombocytopenia is critical to reducing morbidity and mortality.
